checks.name: Desktop row selection shows details without starting a transaction; action cancel and empty history preserve the room
Explicit room confirmation writes one event; history dates, CSV and Undo use the same exact resource
Admin history includes the team while Staff and downloaded CSV retain ownership scope
Device selection opens read-only details and exact history before borrower-preserving return controls
Registry history uses the same resource identity and inactive items remain in export preview
Status export is an explicit, keyboard-accessible CSV preview including rooms and omitting borrower codes; failure remains retryable
Details, back, close, cancel, save and export work at phone/tablet/desktop widths in both themes without stacked dialogs
Mobile registry/resource history returns to details; editing a resource retains identity even when it becomes hidden from Quick Log

limitations: Synthetic adapter only; no Firebase/Auth/backend SIT
Automated acceptance is not human UAT or physical Safari/scanner testing
